items.title: Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Lou McGarrity and Vido Musso on “Jersey Bounce,”

ctx.x: Oh Billy Butterfield, a great example, all those Artie Shaw solos, all Benny’s, Lou McGarrity and Vido Musso on “Jersey Bounce,” and the guy that played, I think it was Rollini, on “Stomping at the Savoy.” I mean they were great solos.
And it wasn’t just a matter of playing as many notes as they could in the time they had?
